userRequest:
Build a minimal Express (Node.js) REST API for a to-do list with in-memory storage.

Endpoints:
- POST /todos — body {title}, returns 201 with the created todo {id, title, completed:false, createdAt}
- GET /todos — returns all todos, sorted newest first
- GET /todos/:id — returns one todo or 404
- PATCH /todos/:id — body {title?, completed?}, returns the updated todo or 404
- DELETE /todos/:id — returns 204 or 404

Constraints:
- Express 4, no external database
- Use UUIDs for ids
- Input validation: title required and non-empty on POST; reject unknown body fields on PATCH
- Include a README with install + run instructions (npm install, npm start)
- Listen on port from PORT env var or 3000

{"totalLatencyMs":75351,"wiringPassSummary":"No wiring issues found. All integration points are correctly wired:

- `src/index.js` correctly imports and starts the Express `app` from `src/app.js`.
- `src/app.js` correctly imports `todosRouter` from `src/routes/todos.js` and mounts it at `/todos` with `app.use('/todos', todosRouter)`.
- `src/routes/todos.js` correctly imports the in-memory store (default export) from `src/store.js`; all five route handlers (POST, GET /, GET /:id, PATCH /:id, DELETE /:id) are registered on the router and the router is exported as default.
- `src/store.js` correctly exports both the `todos` array (default) and the `reset` helper (named), which is consumed by the test suite.
- `src/__tests__/todos.test.js` correctly imports `app` and `reset` from their respective modules.

Build and all 13 tests pass cleanly.","generalPassSummary":"Found 1 issue, fixed 1. Issue: In `src/routes/todos.js`, the `GET /todos` sort comparator (`new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt)`) had no tiebreaker for equal timestamps. When two todos are created in rapid succession within the same millisecond, their `createdAt` values are identical and the sort is non-deterministic, causing the "newest first" contract to be violated. Fixed by adding an insertion-order tiebreaker (`todos.indexOf(b) - todos.indexOf(a)`) so that when timestamps are equal, later-inserted items still sort first.","overall":"FIXED_ISSUES","finalBuildExitCode":0,"finalBuildPassed":true}
